column1: # Dubai, IACAD: its perpetual zone tables for Dubai, Dubai Rural and Hatta (profiles-tested.md,
# data-gulf-egypt): yearly spreadsheets on iacad.gov.ae, 2022–2025 identical by month and day, read
# from Wayback captures. The 2026–2029 files are that table mapped onto those dates (derived: a
# perpetual table against the sun of each year of a leap cycle; Khaleej Times' September 2026 copy
# matches it on 30 of 30 days). Each table is checked at its unit's reference point. No end of eating
# is printed: the fast begins at its Fajr (F+E). Standard Asr.
# Split, forward in time: fit on the captured years (Dubai 2022 to June 2025, a whole leap cycle;
# Dubai Rural the same; Hatta 2023 to June 2025); held out, the table mapped onto 2026–2029, the
# years the app shows (Dubai Rural's mapped 2026 only). A zone's table is the official one at every
# point of the zone, so it is also checked at towns across it (its unit's point rides as the fixed
# point there, ruling R15): Dubai's from Jebel Ali and the Marina in the west to Deira, Al Qusais,
# Mirdif and Al Mizhar in the north and east; Dubai Rural's at Lahbab, its north.
